articles.title: Sam Bankman-Fried loses appeal to overturn 25-year prison sentence
articles.snippet: A federal appeals court upheld the former FTX chief’s conviction, while his bid for clemency from President Donald Trump appears to face steep political odds.

articles.title: Sam Bankman-Fried Loses Appeal as Federal Court Upholds 'Robust' Fraud Conviction
articles.snippet: Disgraced FTX founder Sam Bankman-Fried has applied for a pardon from President Trump, which is now his one remaining path out of prison.
